title: Independent action-selection admissibility requirement after rank-one non-identifiability
question: Can the currently source-locked RTK repository select a unique full projectable rank-one nonlinear action without using the already observed soft-s obstruction as fitting data?
admissibility_requirements: candidate full action is written explicitly before any new soft-s evaluation
field map from rank-one variables to ADM/clock variables is explicit
lapse and shift dependence are derived from the same action
symmetric potential/algebraic matrix is fixed independently of the failed soft-s observable
source direction is derived from the same action rather than chosen by response fitting
background coefficient functions are fixed by an independent symmetry, microscopic construction, or already certified lower-order physics
full nonlinear action is sufficient for a complete Dirac constraint count
candidate must subsequently re-certify background equivalence, quadratic pole/residue/remainder, static/canonical regularity, and C9 radiative naturalness before any soft-s retest

decision_rule.ACTION_SELECTION_READY_PASS_SCOPED: Only if a repository source predating the new soft-s retest supplies every admissibility item without fitting to s6fM or later soft-s results.
decision_rule.NO_ADMISSIBLE_INDEPENDENT_ACTION_SELECTI: If one or more required action-selection data remain unspecified, retain the s6fT blocker and do not invent a preferred nonlinear action.

scope: Action-selection identifiability/admissibility only. A blocked result is not a no-go for RTK or rank-one completions; it means the present source-locked theory does not uniquely select one nonlinear action.
